foundation.name: Synthetic Pilot Invoices

problem.value: Pilot users lose track of who has already been chased

workaround.value: A small unfinished local JavaScript invoice tracker

desiredOutcome.value: Find the last manual follow-up without reconstructing the history

solution.value: The founder reports that the tracker totals unpaid invoices

constraints: Preserve existing JavaScript modules, manifest and instructions
Local synthetic records only; no reminders or email
unknowns: Whether this ordering helps the owner decide the next manual follow-up
Buyer and willingness to pay are unknown

intention.statement: I want to grow a B2B company.

consequence.value: Delays may consume time that could be spent on paid work

feedback.summary: Two pilot users struggled to choose which invoice to chase
feedback.source: Synthetic founder message, not a customer interview record

feedback.summary: One pilot user requested automatic reminders
feedback.source: Synthetic founder message, not a verified customer quote

feedback.summary: Users can see invoices but lose track of who was already chased

assessment.promising: Reported feedback identifies missing follow-up history.
assessment.weak: The earlier oldest-first proposal would not address the corrected problem.
assessment.criticalUnknown: Does visible follow-up history resolve the confusion?
assessment.cheapestCheck: Replay a recent follow-up using the reported history.

brief.summary: That changes the problem: users are reconstructing follow-up history, not missing an overdue sort. Your reported feedback supports testing that workflow; it does not establish demand for automatic reminders.
brief.nextAction: Review one example of reconstructing the history.
